sloka: संदिदेश अति मति मान् नीलम् नित्य कृत उद्यमम् ।दिक्षु सर्वासु सर्वेषाम् सैन्यानाम् उपसंग्रहे ॥४-२९-२९॥
transliteration: saṁdideśa ati mati mān nīlam nitya kṛta udyamam ।dikṣu sarvāsu sarveṣām sainyānām upasaṁgrahe ॥4-29-29॥

translations.english: Sugriva who had a great sense of duty, started applying his mind, when he heard the honest advice of Hanuman.
